item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00489","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C06","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template for the child's transportation provisions. Both assign the Interstate Commerce Commission substantially the same machinery for assessing emergency transportation requirements and resources, allocating transportation and storage capacity, administering traffic priorities, acting as claimant for materials and manpower, coordinating passenger and freight movement with private organizations, and meeting military and civilian requirements. The child expands and reorganizes this machinery for comprehensive emergency preparedness, but the parallel operative sequence and target-specific language go well beyond shared subject matter. C06 is a strong secondary source for the overarching emergency-preparedness framework and the reservation against implementing plans, while C02 supplies some related civil-defense terminology and administrative context.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Periodically assemble, develop as appropriate, and evaluate requirements for domestic surface transportation and storage in an emergency, taking into account estimated needs for military as well as civilian purposes.","parent_excerpt":"Assemble and analyze data with respect to requirements to be imposed on domestic transportation and storage systems and facilities and with respect to the ability of such systems and facilities to satisfy such requirements.","explanation":"Both begin the operative transportation machinery by assembling and evaluating requirements against available transportation and storage capacity."},{"child_excerpt":"Prepare plans for the allocation of the use of domestic surface transportation and storage by operators and users, and to administer such priorities systems as may be necessary to insure expeditious movement of essential freight and passengers.","parent_excerpt":"Allocate the use of domestic transportation and storage facilities by operators thereof, and allocate domestic transportation and storage services to the users thereof. Administer such priorities as may be necessary to insure the movement of essential traffic.","explanation":"This is a close substantive and linguistic adaptation of the same paired facilities.","explanation":"The child preserves C12's specialized claimancy function while broadening the listed resources and emergency responsibilities."},{"child_excerpt":"Develop plans with appropriate private transportation and storage organizations and associations for the coordination and direction of the use of domestic surface transportation and storage facilities for movement of passenger and freight traffic.","parent_excerpt":"Coordinate and direct the domestic movement of passenger and freight traffic in cooperation with the Interstate Commerce Commission and private freight traffic."},{"child_excerpt":"These plans and programs will be designed to develop a state of readiness in these areas with respect to all conditions of national emergency, including attack
